column1: # crawl-bench-loop-baseline.tsv -- the v6 leg BEFORE the per-repository loop
# was removed, so the after/before comparison survives the loop's deletion.
# These rows cannot be re-derived by running crawl-bench.sh: the code that
# produced them (one served process, one sqlite database and one program load
# per repository) is gone from that script. They are a pinned MEASUREMENT, not
# a target, and report_loop_delta prints them beside today's run.
# Measured 2026-07-31 on the ~/orgs/grafana corpus (389 checkouts, 250 usable),
# extractor = the v6/sprefa-extract release build, nice -n 19, by running the
# previous script's v6 leg directly against a prepared WORK directory:
# The extraction leg is identical on both sides of the comparison (one row per
# extracted file, `--family cst,type,call,df ... >/dev/null && printf`), so the
# only variable is the loop. The row counts agreed exactly: repo_file 2890 and
# extracted 2890 at cap 32, both before and after.
